tools.name: base_balance
tools.description: Wallet balance on Base: the native ETH balance of any address, read live from the chain. Input: address. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_erc20_balance
tools.description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet on Base (USDC or any other token), formatted with symbol and decimals. Input: wallet address and token address. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_portfolio
tools.description: Wallet portfolio value on Base: ETH plus major tokens (or up to 20 tokens you choose), each holding priced in USD from live DEX prices, with the total. Input: wallet address. Price: $0.004 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_allowance
tools.description: ERC-20 allowance check on Base: how much a spender is still approved to move from an owner's token balance, and whether the approval is unlimited. Run before a swap, an approve or a revoke. Input: token, owner, spender. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_basename
tools.description: Basename lookup: resolve a Base name such as jesse.base.eth to its wallet address, with avatar and profile text records. Input: name. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_tx
tools.description: Base transaction lookup by hash: sender, recipient, value, function selector, block, and whether it succeeded or reverted. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_receipt
tools.description: Base transaction receipt by hash: success or reverted, gas used, and the decoded ERC-20 Transfer events showing which tokens moved between which addresses. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_contract
tools.description: What is this Base address? Wallet (EOA) or smart contract, code size, proxy implementation address, and whether it is an ERC-20, ERC-721 or ERC-1155 token. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_gas
tools.description: Current gas price on Base in gwei: base fee, suggested priority fee and max fee per gas, read live from the chain. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_block
tools.description: Base block lookup by number or tag (latest, safe, finalized): timestamp, gas and transaction count. Price: $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_token
tools.description: Token info for any ERC-20 on Base by contract address: name, symbol, decimals and total supply. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_price
tools.description: Token price on Base by contract address: live USD price and pool liquidity from Uniswap v2/v3 and Aerodrome. Works for any token with a DEX pool, including newly launched ones. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_transfers
tools.description: Recent ERC-20 transfers on Base for a token, a wallet, or both: who sent how much to whom, across up to 2,000 recent blocks (100 results max). Price: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_nft_owner
tools.description: Who owns this NFT? Current owner of an ERC-721 token on Base by contract address and token id (ownerOf). Price: $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_nft_metadata
tools.description: NFT metadata on Base for an ERC-721 or ERC-1155 token: token URI plus the name, image and attributes it points to, resolved from IPFS, Arweave, data URIs or https. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_call
tools.description: Simulate a read-only contract call on Base (eth_call) without sending a transaction: returns the raw result or the revert reason. Use it to dry-run a call before signing. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: base_estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate the gas and the cost in ETH and USD of a Base transaction before signing it. Input: to, and optionally from, data and value. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.description: Deterministic seven-pillar opportunity score. Price: $0.25 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.description: Deterministic invoice aging and next-action triage. Price: $0.50 USDC on Base via x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: base_token_risk · Private data: base_token_risk_trial, base_token_risk, base_balance, base_erc20_balance, base_portfolio, base_allowance, base_basename, base_receipt, base_contract, base_token, base_price, base_transfers, base_nft_owner, base_nft_metadata · Public sink: base_token_risk · Destructive: base_allowance, base_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: base_token_risk · Private data: base_token_risk_trial, base_token_risk, base_balance, base_erc20_balance, base_portfolio, base_allowance, base_basename, base_receipt, base_contract, base_token, base_price, base_transfers, base_nft_owner, base_nft_metadata · Public sink: base_token_risk · Destructive: base_allowance, base_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
